summary: First rework of the detailer tracker: v1 shipped four separate workbooks that force double entry, with no dashboard or charts for preview images, and no view of profit after mileage or money to set aside for tax.

required_changes.change: Merge the four workbooks into one workbook with tabs. Each job is entered once and feeds income and customer history; supply purchases count as costs without being re-entered as expenses.
required_changes.reason: Four separate files force double entry (jobs in both the Income sheet and the Customer Log; supplies in both the Supply Cost Tracker and Expenses), a top refund and review complaint.
required_changes.acceptance: One .xlsx in the download; Customers and Summary formulas read the Jobs and Supplies tabs directly.

required_changes.change: Add a Dashboard sheet with key figures and charts (income vs costs by month, profit after mileage by month, costs by category) using chart types that work in Excel and Google Sheets.
required_changes.reason: Listings need preview images, and buyers expect a visual summary; v1 had no dashboard or charts.
required_changes.acceptance: Dashboard tab with three charts whose series read the Summary tab; Testing checks the chart references.

required_changes.change: Show profit after the IRS standard mileage deduction, monthly and for the year.
required_changes.reason: Mobile detailers drive all day; profit before mileage overstates what they earn.
required_changes.acceptance: Dashboard 'Profit After Mileage' = Net Profit - Mileage Deduction, tested by a scenario.

required_changes.change: Add a user-set Tax Set-Aside % on the Dashboard and the amount to put aside (zero on a loss), plus take-home after the set-aside.
required_changes.reason: Self-employed buyers want to know how much to save for taxes; a fixed rate would be wrong for many.
required_changes.acceptance: Editable % cell (default 25%); Tax Set-Aside = ROUND(MAX(0, Profit After Mileage) x %, 2), tested by scenarios.

findings.issue: Four separate files force double entry.
No dashboard or charts for preview images.
No profit after mileage deduction or user-set tax set-aside %.
